# Vendored assets

Third-party assets are served from here rather than a CDN, so the app works
offline and makes no third-party requests at runtime. It holds health data; it
shouldn't be phoning anyone.

## Chart.js 4.4.4 — `chart.umd.min.js`

MIT License, (c) Chart.js Contributors. https://www.chartjs.org

The file keeps its own copyright banner at the top, which is the notice MIT
requires.

## Webfonts — `fonts.css`, `fonts/*.woff2`

All three families are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which
requires the licence and copyright notice travel with the font files. Full text
for each is alongside them:

| Family         | Licence                    |
| -------------- | -------------------------- |
| Inter          | `fonts/OFL-Inter.txt`          |
| Newsreader     | `fonts/OFL-Newsreader.txt`     |
| JetBrains Mono | `fonts/OFL-JetBrains-Mono.txt` |

Only the `latin` and `latin-ext` subsets are included. Note these are variable
fonts: one file covers several weights, so filenames are keyed by family and
subset rather than by weight.

## Refreshing

`fonts.css` was generated by trimming the Google Fonts CSS to those subsets and
rewriting each `src` URL to a local path. If you regenerate it, check that every
`url(fonts/…)` reference resolves to a file that actually exists — sharing one
file across weights makes that easy to get wrong.
